paper.title: Spindle: Efficient Distributed Training of Multi-Task Large Models via Wavefront Scheduling
paper.public_version_note: Author arXiv 2409.03365v3, 2025-02-11, 20 pages. Formal DOI absent from PDF; exact title and all author names match formal program metadata. Landing-page revision history retained. Not asserted byte-identical to publisher version.

reading.scope: Physical pages 2–13 body (page 13 before References) and 18–20 appendices A–H. Page 1 abstract/intro is not newly counted. Pages 14–17 bibliography were locator-only, not body reading. No cited-paper, model, downloaded-code or simulator execution inferred.

findings.claim: Workload heterogeneity across model branches, shared-component dependencies, and per-component measured scaling curves change resource allocation. MetaOp contraction is not kernel fusion.
Measured cluster: at most 64 A800 80 GB, intra-node NVLink, inter-node 400 Gbps IB. Paper models are 1.20B Multitask-CLIP, 0.66B OFASys, 9.25B QWen-VAL. QWen-VAL 30B/70B on 256 GPUs is simulation.
Dynamic task-set experiment saves and reloads the model when tasks change; execution planning time does not cover complete reconfiguration cost.

paper_to_framework_gap: Fixed official spindle branch 1c03a149c3aabcf3eac9585d44dd5cec8933edff, 2025-03-19; root README is general Galvatron-2.

Selected planner/graph source exposes candidate graph scheduling and profiling functions; selected device_mapping uses a placement proxy rather than explicit byte/bandwidth/memory scoring in that function.

Complete mapping to paper SpindleTask runtime, shared-parameter groups, multi-task configurations and recovery is not established by selected files. No whole-framework absence assertion or end-to-end reproduction claim.

evidence_only_caveats.claim: Positive non-increasing T alone is insufficient for the printed static equal-finish theorem: 2 unit tasks, 2 resources, T=1/n^2 gives static time 1 and serial time 0.5. Independent arithmetic; cited prior theory unread; no inference that measured experiments are invalid.
Figure 10 shows 6.2% in one Spindle cell; prose approximates an upper bound of 6%. Do not adopt as universal bound; Sp* w/o DP in this ablation refers to device placement.

prior_abstract_screening.reason: Spindle 针对多任务多模态训练的共享组件与依赖做 wavefront 调度，候选对应第 10 章；不由摘要推断适用于所有 MoE 或 RL 工作流。

editorial_decision.decision: 重点阅读，建议有限整合到延伸材料
editorial_decision.placement: Existing 10.3.1, optional branch variant of experiment 10-5 and existing figure 10-5; no new core section or core experiment.
editorial_decision.incremental_judgment: Branch-specific scaling curves and shared dependency joins can reverse resource allocation after exposed handoff and complete reconfiguration cost are included.

scope: Selected body/code reading and independent teaching arithmetic only.
